g.title: j1822080193
g.text: So how'd you end up getting involved in the whole Arthur/Hex thing?

g.title: j63187966
g.text: You seem to really... REALLY hate Entrati. Why?

g.title: j500143664
g.text: Worse than the bloodbath where Arthur and I became hermanos

g.title: j1936508499
g.text: I promised to follow him anywhere
Seems like he meant to the edge of Mictlán

g.title: j1727308772
g.text: If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.

g.title: j4120863329
g.text: No problem. Plenty of shit I haven't told you, yet.

g.title: j2054342157
g.text: We were stationed together in the same base
Him in the Britannic and me with the Libertatian Army

g.title: j2949018593
g.text: I was the field medic for my regiment
We were deployed in next to his

g.title: j2948372999
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
And that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j2328844224
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
And that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j4003883637
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j2597041058
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he mistreated those poor animals
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j3787665541
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he abandoned his family
And that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j3223590703
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he abandoned that man who loves him
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j1848603558
g.text: But after everything you told me
About how he abandoned his family
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j3283377840
g.text: But after everything you told me
How could I not hate that cabrón?!

g.title: j1749687474
g.text: You want to hear about all the times I've had to put someone down or take off a limb
The times I've had a mother weeping next to their dead child and had to tell her I couldn't save her
I see it all the time

g.title: j1492807050
g.text: We all have the things we don't tell people
Until we're very certain we can trust them not to change how they feel

g.title: j70141489
g.text: Most of my crew didn't make it
I stitched his arm up good jaja
When he retired and went into the ICR
I was sick of all the drama that goes on in the army anyway

g.title: j237362312
g.text: The way you talk about him, and because I know how much trust is important to you... It seems personal.

g.title: j580115327
g.text: I know how much you hate it when people break the trust of others. Especially animals.

g.title: j4080131478
g.text: People who hurt animals have a special place in hell, absolutely. But it seems like there's more going on than that.

g.title: j2901061298
g.text: Yeah, but it seems like a personal grudge you have against him.

g.title: j2912169627
g.text: It might change how you look at some of us babas
And I don't know if I trust you enough not to walk away

g.title: j3732616812
g.text: Do you not trust me yet?

g.title: j3778887929
g.text: We've all made mistakes in life. I'm sure it can't be that bad.

g.title: j3111749201
g.text: Careful, or else I might start to think you're getting attached to me.

g.title: j2077847277
g.text: Then what? How'd you get to be...

g.title: j4224906138
g.text: War sucks. No matter when, no matter how.

g.title: j2475792607
g.text: Our wars must seem so small
Yours sound tan espectaculares y llamativas
Filled with dioses, ángeles y demonios

g.title: j1007923650
g.text: Need a new nickname for you, ¿eh babas? Jaja

g.title: j3654891913
g.text: Animals most of all deserve the best we can give them
And when trust is broken like that
It makes me want to kill a man

g.title: j4030355016
g.text: Can I ask what he did?

g.title: j766040088
g.text: If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.

g.title: j4196049080
g.text: Ese cabrón se puede ir brincando a la chingada

g.title: j3606155304
g.text: Gotten used to having you underfoot, babas
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head

g.title: j2755266498
g.text: Or maybe I'm just happy to have someone around who is useful babas

g.title: j171178893
g.text: You want to hear about all the times I've had to put someone down or take off a limb
The times I've had a mother weeping next to their dead child and had to tell her I couldn't save her
I see it all the time

g.title: j1977514645
g.text: Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head

g.title: j3922132096
g.text: Is that what you think you are?

g.title: j3162752076
g.text: But I guess in the end it's all the same
People dying in the muck and mud
And La Flaca takes them home

g.title: j3828440360
g.text: If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.

g.title: j549909056
g.text: Not something I want to get into

g.title: j4239167140
g.text: I don't recall voting on it

g.title: j3457841771
g.text: Sounds like you made it up
I don't recall voting on it

g.title: j913617146
g.text: I don't know what he did to you, but... sounds like it was rough.

g.title: j471429123
g.text: Can I ask what he did?

g.title: j1439669146
g.text: I get it. Not a problem.

g.title: j3775740342
g.text: Like that stitched together creature from that book

g.title: j3724585116
g.text: How'd you wind up meeting Entrati, though?

g.title: j3316889320
g.text: Can I ask what happened next?

g.title: j3978122022
g.text: You want to hear about all the times I've had to put someone down or take off a limb
The times I've had a mother weeping next to their dead child and had to tell her I couldn't save her
I see it all the time

g.title: j1892104055
g.text: Has no one told you what happened?

g.title: j930873982
g.text: But I get what you're asking
And you've been dancing around the subject like you want to do the tango
You know I don't want to talk about it
Has no one told you what happened?

g.title: j2022754805
g.text: Not something I want to get into

g.title: j1087255036
g.text: Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
Don't let it go to your head

g.title: j4052005259
g.text: I'm just trying to get the whole picture.

g.title: j16381940
g.text: No one else will tell me. They just avoid the subject.

g.title: j3974982094
g.text: I figured you'd be the one to give me a straight answer.

g.title: j2989513893
g.text: I get it. Not a problem.

g.title: j3678241872
g.text: You're a far cry from a lab rat, Lettie.

g.title: j2196384052
g.text: Well, I think rats are intelligent, social, adorable wonderful animals...

g.title: j3547206764
g.text: Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza

g.title: j1242075219
g.text: Gotten used to having you underfoot
Might miss you if you leave
No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza

g.title: j1390517127
g.text: Tossed aside when the use was done
Dangerous if left to spread their diseases

g.title: j443563746
g.text: And if nobody else will tell you I guess it's up to Mamá Lettie
Well this story is one I don't like to tell
Especially because I've gotten used to having you underfoot

g.title: j2000326709
g.text: And figure Mamá Lettie would tell you the truth
But this one I don't like to tell
Especially because I've gotten used to having you underfoot

g.title: j3438863893
g.text: This one I don't like to tell
Especially because I've gotten used to having you underfoot

g.title: j419698333
g.text: What do you mean, "spread their diseases?"

g.title: j1175054299
g.text: A lab rat isn't to blame for the things the scientists force on them.

g.title: j3517456665
g.text: But it doesn't mean they should be allowed to spread their diseases

g.title: j2916912701
g.text: You know how to make me smile
But it doesn't mean they should be allowed to spread their diseases

g.title: j754919662
g.text: You're a far cry from a lab rat, Lettie.

g.title: j3389784981
g.text: Then what're you suggesting we do? Put you all down?

g.title: j1791206067
g.text: Might miss you if you leave
And this story might make you turn and go
So a story for another day
No dejes que se te suba a la cabeza

g.title: j3544745864
g.text: Tossed aside when the use was done
Dangerous if left to spread their diseases

g.title: j3028270775
g.text: If we weren't trapped in this loop
You'd have to or we'd go mad like the bruja metiche did in that nightmare

g.title: j1192097852
g.text: That Entrati cabrón deserves to die a slow and painful death
And I hope I get to be the one that delivers him to La Flaca personally

g.title: j2039377361
g.text: That Entrati cabrón deserves to die a slow and painful death
And I hope I get to be the one that delivers him to La Flaca personally

g.title: j3038411092
g.text: You're not to blame for any of this, Lettie.

g.title: j4024004774
g.text: Well, with transference it could be slowed...

g.title: j547501526
g.text: Pero it's not a story I'm telling today
And too much shit in that story for today
Back to work for both of us

g.title: j2039990764
g.text: I don't need protecting, you should know that by now

g.title: j1250196312
g.text: Trapped here we cannot do much harm anymore

g.title: j3640057215
g.text: Back to work for both of us
